steps.en: The individual Director/Partner details are received
steps.why_en: Director data is fetched but not saved, and the job is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Data director diambil tapi tidak disimpan, dan job dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: The notice owner is changed to the individual Director/Partner
steps.id: Pemilik di notice diganti menjadi Director/Partner individu
steps.why_en: No logic replaces the company with the person on the notice.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika yang mengganti perusahaan dengan orangnya di notice.

steps.en: The notice is moved back to the 1st reminder stage
steps.id: Notice dikembalikan ke stage reminder pertama
steps.why_en: No logic moves the notice back based on the registry result.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika yang memundurkan notice berdasarkan hasil registry.

steps.en: The 1st reminder letter is made and sent to the individual Director/Partner
steps.id: Surat reminder pertama dibuat dan dikirim ke Director/Partner individu
steps.why_en: Generic letter generation exists, but it is not tied to this person and printer upload is blocked by configuration.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan surat generik ada, tapi tidak terikat ke orang ini dan upload ke percetakan diblok konfigurasi.
